title: Elegant, private and just works as expected
body: This app doesn’t hoard your data and doesn’t overload you with features you’ll never use. It just works with an elegant design with simple menus and great widgets. Feels rare to find something this good that’s also this humble about it. Outstanding work!
author: GeekyNerd01

title: Awesome
body: This app is awesome. The app has some ready made habit templates but you can also make your own habits as you wish and edit them. I like the history section too and that you can see trends and see how well I’ve done on each habit. It has just the right amount of features and customization for me, not too little and not too much that it would be overwhelming. I think the simple design also helps it feeling just right. The widgets are great and I love that I can have one on the lock screen. Has been a really helpful app for me.
author: Artifical Suicide

title: Paywall
body: A habit app that doesn’t let you have more than 3 habits is not a habit app
